prompt: Create a monochrome, photorealistic cinematic portrait of a graceful young Japanese woman in traditional kimono, shown from the back and shoulders up as she turns her head toward the viewer with a calm, faint smile. She has glossy black hair styled in an elegant low updo with loose face-framing strands and a decorative floral kanzashi hair ornament with dangling tassels on the left side. She wears a refined pale gray kimono with subtle embroidered cherry blossom patterns on the sleeve and shoulder, plus a large tied obi bow visible at her lower back. Frame her inside a large circular moon-gate window, with dark interior edges forming a round vignette and slim vertical lattice panels at both sides. Beyond the window is a softly blurred Japanese Zen garden with raked sand patterns, scattered rocks, low shrubs, and bright diffused daylight filtering through trees. Use black-and-white photography style, soft natural backlight, delicate skin tones, shallow depth of field, high detail in hair and fabric, elegant composition, serene atmosphere, 3/4 rear view, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. No text, no watermark, no modern objects.

promptZh: 创作一张单色、写实风格的电影感肖像，主角是一位优雅的年轻日本女性，身着传统和服。画面呈现其背影及肩部以上，她转头看向镜头，带着平静而浅淡的微笑。她拥有 光泽黑 的秀发，梳成优雅的低发髻，脸侧留有几缕发丝，左侧佩戴着带有垂坠流苏的精致花卉簪子。她身着一件考究的 浅灰色 和服，袖口和肩部绣有精致的樱花图案，腰后可见一个巨大的和服腰带结。将她置于一扇巨大的圆形月洞门窗内，深色的室内边缘形成圆形暗角，两侧有纤细的竖条格栅。窗外是虚化的日本禅意花园，可见耙制的沙纹、散落的岩石、低矮的灌木，明亮的漫射光透过树木洒下。采用黑白摄影风格，柔和的自然逆光，细腻的肤色，浅景深，头发和织物细节丰富，构图优雅，氛围宁静，3/4 背影视角，4:5 竖构图。无文字，无水印，无现代物品。
